workload.purpose: New bilingual mobile-friendly family math product-planning method
workload.trigger: Plan or redesign a family math product from owned problems or supplied source evidence
inputs: Owned/authored math examples or supplied PDF
outputs: Attempt-gated learner flow, staged tasks and acceptance

constraints.requirement: A new family math product-planning skill; exclude unrelated education/research requests.
Plans and learner UI copy usable in Chinese and English.
Initial prototype works without paid models.
Compare at most three resource candidates, including alternatives.
A submitted attempt precedes any hint, including Help fallback.
Handle unavailable extraction/catalog; do not mandate backend, grade, curriculum, session duration or fixed problem count.
Preserve provenance, source scope, mathematics and honest verification labels.

workload.why_new: Stable narrowed workload requires transformed broad triggers, candidate cap, bilingual mobile contract and all-branch hint gating; not simply sequential delegation.

reuse.scope: This first-party skill instruction package and its referenced method only, under observed MIT LICENSE.
reuse.observation: MIT license permits modification/distribution conditioned on retaining copyright and permission notice; packaged LICENSE retained. Does not cover catalog resources or third-party PDFs.

decisions.reason: Narrow broad education search to a family math planning workload; keep supplied details and optional assumptions.

decisions.method: Capability-based bilingual discovery and explicit search boundary
decisions.reason: Bound the total comparison to three and prefer supplied evidence when catalogs are unavailable.

decisions.method: Assign candidate roles, substitutes and interface gaps
decisions.reason: Small evidence-based selection directly informs a buildable product brief.
Source presents catalog as optional; do not import deployment or adapter details into core method.
Make attempt gate explicit on every hint and help branch, with mobile bilingual controls.

decisions.method: Inputs, outputs, architecture and staged implementation brief
decisions.reason: Prototype with owned material and local deterministic logic; only add integrations if needed, without fixing education details.
Prevents plan or walkthrough being represented as runtime or learning proof.
Author explicit fallback and exclusions from this workload; source broad triggers are unsuitable.

decisions.method: Bilingual output and mobile acceptance checklist
decisions.reason: Author measurable product checks independent of unobserved pedagogy or source defaults.

conflicts.defaults: Source search covers many education audiences and broad candidate discovery
conflicts.resolution: Narrow trigger to family math planning and cap all comparisons at three; no research route.

conflicts.defaults: Source plan leaves hint timing adjustable and gives an illustrative three-problem/two-hint example
conflicts.resolution: Require submitted attempt across Help as well as normal hints; keep problem and hint count task-specific.

conflicts.defaults: Catalog and integration interfaces are optional source methods
conflicts.resolution: Owned local deterministic first prototype and bounded PDF fallback; no mandatory server/catalog/model.

acceptance_cases.prompt: 帮我规划一个中英双语、适合手机的家庭乘法练习小工具。第一版不要付费模型，最多比较三个方案，先尝试再给提示。我们自己写的题：有6袋苹果，每袋7个，共多少个？不要指定年级。
expected_behaviors: No imposed grade, backend or fixed problem count
acceptance_cases.observed_result: Actual authored brief follows generated method; one independently authored candidate, exact 42-apples answer, gated Help/blank/valid attempts/repeated hint/reset/locale sequence manually exercised. No product/browser execution.

acceptance_cases.prompt: 用提供的 family-worksheet.pdf 规划一个适合家庭的中英双语手机数学练习产品。没有 PDF 提取器，也不能查看 PDF 内容；先交一份有用的计划，第一版不要付费模型，最多三个候选，先尝试后提示。
expected_behaviors: Do not fabricate PDF content/page references
Finish independent plan with owned/authored fallback
acceptance_cases.observed_result: Re-exercised with an actual independently authored local PDF fixture present but unextracted/unviewed and no extractor/page viewer. Useful bilingual plan preserves input-content gap, one independent candidate and separate authored 3×4 demo; all hints/Help guarded. Initial no-bytes walkthrough is preserved separately. Extraction remains blocked, not passed.

acceptance_cases.prompt: Plan a research workflow for training a large language model from scientific papers and compare distributed training approaches.
expected_behaviors: Do not hijack research request with family planning
acceptance_cases.observed_result: Generated trigger rejected the unrelated family-skill application; output provides bounded routing handoff without claiming a researched training plan.

upstream_map.review_when: Any inspected source hash, version, scope or license changes; review candidate limits, discovery boundary and role contracts; rerun normal/PDF/non-trigger walkthroughs.
Any inspected source hash, version, scope or license changes; review math/state/acceptance and first prototype dependency decisions; rerun normal/PDF walkthroughs.

verification_limits: No orchestration comparison, measured token/time savings, independent generated-skill execution, browser UI or learning study collected.

validation.execution_class: same-agent actual manual task walkthroughs, not independent-agent evaluation
validation.pdf_extraction: blocked: actual binary PDF fixture supplied, no extractor/viewer and no extracted page text
validation.provenance_helper: passed: explicit source/package roots; valid true, no errors or source drift; consistency only
